messages:
anna: deploy-bot flagged embed_recall_delta on eu-dedicated after rolling redwood-3.10.2 -> delta=0.045 (>0.04).

chris: can we get a quick staging replicate?

deploy-bot: autoprobe: metric embed_recall_delta=0.045, samples=980, confidence=0.88. suggested actions: PAUSE_ROLLOUT, PARTIAL_PIN (eu).

chris: ran staging A/B with same seed => delta=0.047. looks reproducible.

kevin (pm): change window open for 3h; if we rollback now global plan is interrupted. prefer targeted pin to limit blast radius.

julia (support): two customers already reported "semantic search mismatch" on dedicated EU. prepping customer note.

anna: ops, propose pin to redwood-3.9.9 on eu-ded pools for 2h while eng-ml digs in.

opsbot: runbook command suggested:

```
redwoodctl rollout pin --pools eu-ded-05,eu-ded-06 --model redwood-3.9.9 --duration 120m --reason "eu canary embed regression"
```

opsbot: executing...

opsbot: SUCCESS: pin applied. ticket=RD-4955. pools pinned: eu-ded-05, eu-ded-06.

chris: monitoring set: embed_recall_delta, customer_errors, p95-latency. 30m short check then extend.

julia (support): sending targeted customer notices now. draft approved by legal.

kevin (pm): decision: pin + comms + 2h triage. if combined_score > 0.9 or errors > 1% -> escalate to full rollback runbook.

anna: created INF-9180 for eng-ml. please attach staging bench and logs.

chris: noted. will update ticket with diffs and tokenization checks.

julia (support): customers replied; one asked for ETA, replied "investigating, temporary revert applied."

kevin (pm): thanks everyone. keep updates in INF-9180 and this thread for handoff.
